Enter your access key to open Return With Love on this device.

Your key never leaves this device. You will be logged out after 45 minutes of inactivity.

How privacy works

The key is never sent to GitHub or any server. Decryption happens in this browser. After a successful unlock, this tab keeps an encrypted-session credential in session storage and remains unlocked across a reload until 45 minutes of inactivity or until you tap Log out.
